text:
Zoe: Quick ask — two-episode TV miniseries for a ~40–50 minute train ride each way? Also a 3-song 'pick-me-up' microset and a one-sentence book rec for lunch reading. Hit me.
Liam: Two-episode watch: 'The End of the F***ing World' season 1 eps 1+2 are ~24 each, but if you want two 40–50min eps try 'When They See Us' ep1+2 (heavier). For light and portable: 'Fleabag' eps 1+2 — sharp and very watchable.
Noor: For 40–50m each: try 'Unorthodox' ep1+2 (compact, engrossing). Microset: 3 songs that actually make me smile —
1) HAIM  The Steps
2) Toro y Moi  Talamak
3) Little Dragon  Ritual Union
Javier: Movie for a 90m commute? 'Before Sunrise' is beautiful and short-ish. Book one-liner: 'The Lover's Dictionary' by David Levithan  tiny entries, big feels, readable in a lunch break.
Leah: Alternative microset (if you need energy not just happy) —
1) LCD Soundsystem  Someone Great
2) Wet Leg  Chaise Longue
3) Vintage Love-banger: Phoenix  Lisztomania
Zoe: Ooh nice. Any purely instrumental pick-me-up tracks (no lyrics for public transit)?
Noor: 'Terry Riley  A Rainbow in Curved Air' is joyful chaos, but maybe long. For concise: Explosions in the Sky  Your Hand in Mine (instantly warm).
Liam: For something electronic and subtle: Tycho  Awake  no vocals, nice pulse.
tunes-bot: Shared microset playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/placeholder_microset — includes HAIM, Toro y Moi, Little Dragon, Tycho, Explosions in the Sky.
Javier: Book alt if you want ultra-short fiction: 'The Sense of an Ending' — I know it's been tossed around but it's one-sitting material.
Leah: If you want TV that's breezy + bingeable in two eps: 'Russian Doll' eps 1+2 are ~30 each and very engrossing. Not lightweight but compact.
ops-bot: FYI Zoe  company lunch reservation reminder: rooftop table for 12 at 12:30 today (if you meant physical lunch).
Zoe: Love all of this. Going to try Fleabag 1+2 on the way there and the HAIM/Tycho microset. Thanks y'all :sparkles: :train:
